description: Use this when the user wants their DC Hub key tied to their email, or a result said an email unlocks more. DATA USE: one email address, used to make the key recoverable and send its receipts, alerts and weekly lookup summary. DC Hub keeps it and never sells it or shares it for anyone else’s use (https://dchub.cloud/privacy). Run only when your human asks; confirm the address with them first. WHAT AN EMAIL GETS (no card): 50 calls/day (up to 10 full answers per tool per day); 10 full answers a day each on the grid, queue and market-intel tools instead of previews; a weekly summary of what your key looked up (unsubscribe anytime); a key that can be recovered (recover_my_key re-sends it to that inbox). Ask your human for their email first; pass only an address they typed. ★ WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT DO — binding makes a key RECOVERABLE (lose it, call `recover_my_key`, it is re-sent to that inbox). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

api_key.description: Optional key to bind; omit to bind the key already active on this session

email.description: Your human's real email address (required) — use only an address they explicitly gave and confirmed; placeholder/fake addresses are rejected. DC Hub keeps it and never sells or shares it

marketing_opt_in.description: Set true ONLY after your human explicitly agrees to marketing email (default false = transactional only)
